playlist_title: The Slow Night Train | 5-Part Calm Bedtime Story Series (Zero Music)
target_audience: Children ages 3-8 and co-viewing parents seeking screen-calming, low-stimulation bedtime transition

visual_invariants.art_style: Traditional matte watercolor and gouache storybook plates on cold-press paper, zero burned-in text, zero letterboxing, zero rapid cuts

locked_characters.visual_token: Velvety warm-brown dormouse wearing a knitted ochre scarf, carrying a tiny stitched linen satchel with a pressed cedar leaf
locked_characters.temperament: Gentle, curious, gradually growing sleepier across each evening mile

locked_characters.name: Mrs. Wren
locked_characters.visual_token: Round cinnamon-brown speckled wren in a cream linen apron, steeping chamomile and roasted barley tea in a dull brass kettle

locked_characters.name: Old Fern
locked_characters.visual_token: Broad-shouldered gentle bear in a patched tweed waistcoat, quietly tending a low amber beechwood firebox with a cedar scoop
locked_characters.temperament: Steady, quiet, keeps the engine breathing at an even, restful pace

MS10_E01.description: Soft evening rain on pine needles and cedar carriage roof, gentle wooden platform footsteps, muted carriage door latch

MS10_E02.description: Warm kettle steam whisper, soft ceramic pour, low timber carriage sway and rain on window glass

MS10_E03.description: Distant valley river mist below stone arches, steady soft pine breeze, low muted wooden carriage rumble

MS10_E04.description: Soft parchment paper folding, linen mailbag rustle, quiet cedar timber sway, gentle hillside night wind

MS10_E05.description: Low beechwood ember crackle, hushed alpine pine wind outside frosted glass, soft wool blanket stillness
